test_title: PYST 43: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 02 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: On which date did Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi inaugurate the WAVES 2025, India’s first-of-its-kind World Audio Visual and Entertainment Summit, held at Mumbai?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 May 2025.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi** inaugurated **WAVES 2025**, India’s first-of-its-kind World Audio Visual and Entertainment Summit, on **May 1, 2025**, in **Mumbai**.
 
• The event aimed to highlight India's growing prominence in the **global entertainment industry** and foster collaboration among industry stakeholders.
 
• This summit brought together renowned names from the fields of **cinema, music, animation, gaming, and technology**, and served as a platform for showcasing India's creative and technological advancements. *Hence, the date mentioned in option 2 is correct.*
 
• **WAVES 2025** was a multi-day event focusing on critical areas such as content creation, innovation, and the future of entertainment. It also emphasized the role of the Indian government in promoting the entertainment sector.
 
• The summit included **panel discussions, workshops, exhibitions, and networking opportunities** with international and domestic professionals in the entertainment industry. *Hence, the event was significant for India’s entertainment sector.*
 
• **May 1, 2025**, was chosen strategically as it marked the beginning of a new era of collaboration and innovation in the entertainment domain. *Hence, option 2 is correct.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **WAVES Summit:**

 
 
• The **World Audio Visual and Entertainment Summit (WAVES)** is a platform designed to promote the Indian entertainment sector globally.
 
• The summit serves as an opportunity to explore the intersection of **technology, creativity, and business**, showcasing India’s talent and innovation.
 
 
 
• **India’s Entertainment Industry:**
 
 
• The Indian entertainment industry is among the fastest-growing sectors, contributing significantly to the nation’s **GDP and employment**.
 
• It includes industries such as **cinema, television, OTT platforms, animation, gaming, and music**.
 
• India is known for producing the highest number of films annually, and its **Bollywood industry** is globally recognized.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of WAVES 2025:**
 
 
• **Global Participation:** WAVES attracted international industry leaders, fostering collaboration and partnerships.
 
• **Technological Advancements:** The summit showcased innovations in **virtual reality, artificial intelligence, and content creation**.
 
• It focused on how technology is revolutionizing entertainment, with Indian companies playing a pivotal role.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **India’s Global Role in Entertainment:**

 
 
• India is emerging as a hub for **content production, animation, and gaming**, attracting global collaborations.
 
• The government has been actively supporting the entertainment sector through initiatives like **Film Facilitation Office (FFO)** and tax benefits.
 
 
 
• **Significance of WAVES:**
 
 
• **Brand India:** WAVES positions India as a global leader in the **audio-visual and entertainment industry**.
 
• It emphasizes India’s rich culture and heritage, blending traditional storytelling with modern technological advancements.
 
• The summit promotes **collaborations between government and private stakeholders** to boost industry growth.
